description: Use this to say who a draft study should recruit, from a description such as "CTOs at B2B SaaS companies with 50 to 500 employees". GatherHQ tries to set up the targeting and its screener questions from it: when it can, the answer has a test link; when GatherHQ's research team has to finish it, the answer says so and has no test link yet. A live study's audience cannot change from here.

instructions.description: Who to recruit: roles, company size, industry, geography or consumer profile.

study_id.description: The draft study (an id from gather_list_studies).

name: gather_set_study_audience
title: Set a study's audience
